entities.name: Thomas Kaboré
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas Kaboré is a Burkinabe clergyman and bishop for the Roman Catholic Diocese of Kaya. He was ordained in 1970 and appointed bishop in 1999. He retired in 2018.
